concerns.text: The plan calls for a linear mixed‑effects regression of cognitive scores on CLR‑transformed genus abundances with a random intercept for participant ID (US‑2). Since the dataset is cross‑sectional (each participant contributes a single observation), there are no repeated measures; a random intercept is therefore unnecessary and constitutes a misuse of mixed‑effects modeling. This can lead to over‑parameterization, convergence issues, and biased standard errors. Replace the mixed‑effects model with a standard linear regression (or, if longitudinal data become available, retain the mixed‑effects approach).
